external_collaboration.evidence_quote: JLab is proud to partner with powerhouse college athletics. From lively tailgates to coaches play calling, and courtside rivalries to college athlete NIL deals, JLab joins the action and connects with 182M+ fervent college sports fans nationwide.

JLab joins the world of golf – with dynamic partnership with PGA TOUR pros Keegan Bradley and Sepp Straka, top-20 globally ranked players. Kicking off at the Farmers Insurance Open, our collaboration includes prominent JLab logos on Bradley's golf bag, caddie Scott Vail's sleeve, Straka's sleeve, and caddie Duane Bock's sleeve, captivating the international golf audience for years to come. Bradley's distinguished career and Straka's rise highlight JLab's role in enhancing focus and performance.
JLab is the Official Audio Partner of Major League Soccer
